summary: Frontend E2E validation of 3 FREKCORE bug fixes (spec verifier link, /mine isolation notice, cinematic Moment transitions) + /fk regression. All 5 UI tests PASSED. No backend changes were required — only quick sanity call on /api/v1/passport/verifier/python (200 OK).

issues: Screenshot captured during motion transition shows heavy blur on H1 'Signe ce moment.' and sub-headline — this is by design (blur→sharp reveal). Not a bug, just noting the animation is intentionally long/dramatic; sub-headline text may be barely legible for a fraction of second on first load.

bug1_spec_verifier_link.details: data-testid=spec-verifier-link present. href='https://culture-chain.preview.emergentagent.com/api/v1/passport/verifier/python' (full backend URL). target='_blank'. Text='accessible ici'. Backend endpoint returns HTTP 200 (verified via curl).

bug2_mine_isolation_notice.details: data-testid=mine-isolation-notice visible on /mine. Text contains both required phrases: 'Cet espace est privé à ce navigateur' AND 'Ne partage pas cette URL'. Full text: "Cet espace est privé à ce navigateur. Personne d'autre ne peut le voir. Ne partage pas cette URL." Page renders correctly, headline 'Ton univers.' visible.

bug3_cinematic_moment_flow.details: Moment.jsx idle→signing→done sequence works. Clicked moment-sign-btn, moment-done panel appeared within ~4s. Checkmark ✓ present in done panel. Both moment-see-proof and moment-see-block selectors found. Screenshots confirm hero renders (with blur reveal animation) and done panel shows checkmark + block info clearly. Cross-route nav /mine after Moment shows no crash.

regression_fk.details: /fk page renders after AnimatedRoutes wrap. fk-brand, fk-tab-create, fk-tab-verify all visible. Clicking fk-tab-verify reveals fk-verify-drop as expected.

critical_code_review_comments: React Router v6 emits future-flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath). Non-blocking but noisy in console — consider adding future flags to <BrowserRouter> to silence.

Spec.jsx uses `import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` — mixing Vite and CRA env conventions. Works currently because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is defined, but confusing. Same pattern also in MyMoments.jsx.
Moment idle blur reveal animation is aesthetically strong but sub-headline stays blurred for ~0.9s — verify with founder that this delay is acceptable UX-wise.
seed_data_creation: None. Anonymous flow, no credentials required.
